description: Du an nghien cuu an ninh mang toan dien: Phong thu theo chieu sau (Defense-in-Depth) tich hop Lab 01-05, Fail2ban va Auditd

steps.name: Khoi tao he sinh thai Lab99 (Target 10.2.99.10 + Assessor 10.2.99.20)
Kiem toan chi so Lynis va he thong ban dau (Before Hardening)
Tham do be mat tan cong mang ban dau (Nmap scan Lab 01)
Trien khai gia co da tang (SSH 2222, UFW, Sysctl, Static ARP, AppSec)
Xac minh hieu luc cac cau hinh gia co tren Target
Tai kiem toan chi so he thong sau gia co (After Hardening)
Tham do lai be mat mang sau gia co
So sanh dinh luong Before vs After (compare_report.md)
Kiem chung be mat cong khai tu Assessor
Assessor tan cong ARP Spoofing -> Kiem chung phong thu Layer 2 (Lab 02)
Assessor tham dinh DNS -> Kiem chung Source Port Randomization (Lab 03)
Assessor tan cong DoS SYN Flood -> Kiem chung SYN Cookies & Rate Limit (Lab 04)
Assessor tan cong SQLi & RCE -> Kiem chung Prepared Statements & Input Sanitization (Lab 05)
Assessor tan cong SSH Brute-Force -> Kiem chung phong thu chu dong Fail2ban
Gia lap can thiep file he thong -> Kiem chung giam sat truy vet Auditd (HIDS)
Tong hop toan dien ma tran phong thu (project_summary.md)
Dong va giai phong moi truong Lab99
